cases.name: house-lift
cases.gen_prompt: Write a house track in F minor at 122 BPM, form A B A' B with 16-bar sections. B is the chorus: it must lift — noticeably denser and wider in melodic register than A. A' is a varied return of A with busier drums but the same melody. Use separate labeled layers per voice (e.g. kick, hats, snare/clap, bass, chords, lead).

edits.prompt: Make the hats busier. Only the hats — nothing else may change.
The chorus should lift more — push its melodic register higher and make it denser. The verse (A sections) must not change at all.
Swap the bass sound to something darker. The bass notes and rhythm must not change — sound/timbre only.

cases.name: seven-eight
cases.gen_prompt: Write an instrumental groove in 7/8 at 140 BPM, D dorian, form A B C A with 8-bar sections. C is a bridge that withholds the bass entirely; the bass returning in the final A is the payoff. Use separate labeled layers per voice.

edits.prompt: Add a swing/shuffle feel to the hats only. Nothing else may change.
Make the lead melody sparser, but only in the A sections. B and C must not change.

cases.name: lofi
cases.gen_prompt: Write a lo-fi hip-hop beat in C minor at 84 BPM, verse/chorus form A B A B with 8-bar sections, swung hats, jazzy extended chords (7ths/9ths), and a sleepy melody. Use separate labeled layers per voice.

edits.prompt: Halve the harmonic rhythm — the chords should change half as often. Nothing else changes.
Give the drums a velocity contour — accents and ghost notes instead of uniform hits. Timing and which drums hit must not change.

cases.name: trance-transition
cases.gen_prompt: Write a melodic trance track in A minor at 138 BPM, form A B C B with 16-bar sections, where C is a breakdown that sets up the final chorus B. Include riser/fill transition material into each chorus. Use separate labeled layers per voice, with transition material on its own labeled layer(s).

edits.prompt: Make the transition into the final chorus bigger — a longer riser and a drum fill. Only transition material may change.
Change the key from A minor to B minor. All rhythms, contours, and sounds stay exactly the same — pitch transposition only.
